Privacy Policy

Privacy
policy.

Last updated: 13 October 2026

This policy explains which personal data we process when you visit rdd.software or contact us, for what purposes, on what legal basis, and what your rights are. Processing is carried out in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the Croatian Act on the Implementation of the GDPR.

1. Data controller

R.D.D., obrt za računalno programiranje, vl. Milan Trbojević, Mihovilići 2b, 51000 Rijeka, Croatia, OIB (Croatian tax ID): 09887105714, MBO (register number): 98224476 (“RDD”, “we”).
For any data protection questions, write to info@rdd.software.

2. What data we process and why

2.1. Visiting the website (hosting)

The website is served by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., USA), and traffic passes through Cloudflare (Cloudflare, Inc., USA) for speed and protection against attacks. On every visit these providers automatically process technical data: IP address, date and time of access, the requested page, browser and operating system type. This data is necessary to display and protect the website. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

2.2. Automatic language selection

On your first visit, if you have not chosen a language yourself, your browser sends a request to the GeoJS service (get.geojs.io), which determines only your country from your IP address. Based on the country, we show the site in Croatian, English, Italian or German. We do not receive or store your IP address or country. Only the chosen language is saved in your browser. If you choose a language manually, the request is no longer sent. Legal basis: legitimate interest in showing you the site in a language you understand (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

2.3. Analytics (Google Analytics)

We use Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Limited, Ireland) to understand how many visitors we have and which pages interest them. Google Analytics sets cookies (_ga, _ga_*) and collects data about site usage, your device and approximate location. Google Analytics 4 does not store IP addresses. Data may be transferred to Google in the USA. Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time. Google Analytics is loaded only after you click “Accept” in the cookie banner; if you click “Decline”, it is not loaded and sets no cookies. You can change your decision at any time via the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of the page. Data is kept in Google Analytics for at most 14 months.

2.4. Fonts

Fonts are served directly from this website, not from third-party servers (such as Google Fonts), so loading them does not pass your data on to anyone.

2.5. Contact form and email

When you contact us through the contact form or by email, we process your name, email address, company name, project type, estimated budget and the content of your message to reply and, if you wish, to prepare an offer. Legal basis: steps taken at your request prior to entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and legitimate interest in answering enquiries (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). We keep messages as long as needed for the conversation and, if a business relationship results, for as long as accounting and tax regulations require.

Messages sent through the contact form are delivered to our email address by the FormSubmit service (formsubmit.co), which also sends you an automatic confirmation of receipt. The form does not set cookies.

Free consultations are booked through the Cal.com calendar (Cal.com, Inc., USA), which only loads on the page when you click “Show available times”. Cal.com processes your name, email address, the chosen time and any note, sends a confirmation to you and to us, and adds the meeting to our calendar. Legal basis: steps taken at your request prior to entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

2.6. Settings in your browser

In your browser's local storage (localStorage) we save only your settings: the chosen language (rdd-lang), the automatically detected language (rdd-lang-geo), dark or light mode (rdd-theme) and your cookie decision (rdd-consent). This data stays on your device, is not sent to us or to third parties, and you can delete it in your browser settings.

3. Recipients and transfers outside the EU

Data is processed by the service providers listed above (GitHub, Cloudflare, GeoJS, FormSubmit, Cal.com, Google) solely for the purposes described. Some of them are located in or process data in the USA; such transfers are based on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses. We do not sell your data or use it for automated decision-making or profiling.

4. Your rights

Under the GDPR you have the right to:

  • access your data and have it rectified,
  • have your data erased and its processing restricted,
  • object to processing based on legitimate interest,
  • data portability,
  • withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.

Send your request to info@rdd.software; we will reply within one month at the latest. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency (AZOP), Selska cesta 136, 10000 Zagreb, azop.hr, or with the supervisory authority in your country.

5. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time, for example when we add a new service to the website. The current version is always published on this page with the date of the last update.
